过去进行时:was / were doing: 描述"过去某个时刻正在进行的动作",也是讲故事的背景画笔。
结构:was / were + 动词-ing|常与 at that time、at 8 last night 连用|进行时做背景,一般过去时插入事件:was walking when it started to rain|while 引导两个同时进行的动作|不用于状态动词(know、own)
I was watching TV at eight last night.
We were waiting when the news came.
column3: 消息传来时我们正在等。

过去进行时:was / were doing: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
column3: 她做饭的时候电话响了。
他们当时正在为钱吵架。

过去进行时:was / were doing: It was getting darker and darker.

column4: 打电话那刻她"正在"做饭,用过去进行时。

# title: While we ___ , it began to snow.
column4: while + 过去进行时表背景。

# title: At ten yesterday I ___ in the library.
column4: at ten yesterday 指过去时刻,用 was sitting。

# title: The children ___ football at that moment.
He ___ a shower when the doorbell rang.
column4: 门铃响起那刻"正在"洗澡。

# title: I ___ you, so I didn't say hello.
column4: see 表"看见"是感觉动词,否定用一般过去时。
